member.name: NotAfterAnAbbreviation
member.para: The transcript the abbreviation case was caught on. The turbo model writes "Sergeant Mandela 2007-2024 A.D." at 0:25:01 of "The Forever War" (2026-08-14), where a /() chapter/ wording then claimed "D. Chapter" and the match anchored to the earlier segment - 17 s from the announcement, far enough that the mender's distance filter dropped its re-read entirely.
